title: 关系表达式与逻辑表达式

text: Comparisons are values. && || ! combine them.
A comparison such as `x > 3` is a value of type **bool**: true (printed as 1) or false (0).
Any non zero number used as a condition counts as true. So `if (n)` means `if (n != 0)`.
When several operators meet, some bind tighter than others.
**Short circuit**: && stops at the first false part, || at the first true part. So `n != 0 && a / n > 2` never divides by zero.
`if (a = b)` assigns instead of comparing. And `1 < x < 5` means `(1 < x) < 5`, which is always true.
`if (x);` has an empty body: the `;` ends the if. An else pairs with the nearest if, so use braces.
if, else if, else, switch, and the ? : operator.
An else if chain tests its conditions **in order** and runs only the first one that is true.
The second test does not need `bmi >= 18.5`: it only runs when the first one failed.
Order matters. Watch a leap year chain test 400, then 100, then 4.
Leap year: divisible by 4 and not by 100, or divisible by 400. In one line: `(y % 4 == 0 && y % 100 != 0) || y % 400 == 0`.
switch jumps straight to the case that matches an int or a char.
Each case needs `break`, or it falls through into the next. `x = cond ? a : b` picks one of two values.
Decisions inside decisions.
An if inside another if makes a **decision tree**: the inner question is only asked on one branch of the outer one.
Many nests flatten into one else if chain with &&. That is often easier to read.
Without braces, `if (a) if (b) x; else y;` attaches the else to the **inner** if, whatever the indentation says. Brace every nested if.
Complete programs built from branches.

title: Sorting three values and the triangle test

text: Sort the three sides first. Then one test answers each question.
Every test stays in integers, so there is no rounding error. Sorting first removes the "which side is longest" cases.
Work out the cost of every choice and keep the smallest. Start the minimum at `LLONG_MAX`, or at the first choice. This is P1909.
`0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3` is false for doubles. Compare with a tolerance, `fabs(x - y) < 1e-9`, or multiply out so everything stays an integer.
